_doc: 第 11 幕每格背景描述，Claude 看地圖手寫，2026-11-13

EP1-11-01.zh: 鏡頭站在森林小路上，順著小路往前看。小路是一條泥土路，筆直往前延伸很長一段，最後消失在遠處的樹林裡。小路兩邊是茂密的白堊紀森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和高大的針葉樹，樹幹高高聳起，像兩道牆夾著小路。很遠的地方，小路左邊的樹林讓開，露出一片被夕陽照得橘亮的空地；小路遠處還有一截大樹根從地面拱起來，看起來小小的。夕陽在鏡頭正後方，低低地照過來，整條小路被染成橘色，樹影往前拉得很長。
EP1-11-01.en: Background: The camera stands on a forest trail and looks straight along it. The trail is a dirt path that runs straight ahead for a long way and disappears into the trees far away. On both sides of the trail is a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and tall conifers, the trunks rising high like two walls along the trail. Far ahead, the trees on the left side of the trail open up into a forest clearing glowing orange in the sunset light; far along the trail a big tree root sticks up out of the ground, looking small. The setting sun is directly behind the camera, low in the sky; the whole trail is tinted orange and the tree shadows stretch far ahead.
EP1-11-01.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-11-02.zh: 鏡頭站在小路旁邊，橫著看向小路。小路是一條泥土路，從畫面左邊橫過整個畫面延伸到右邊，被夕陽染成橘色。小路對面是一整片茂密的白堊紀森林，蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹的樹幹一根接一根。夕陽在畫面左邊，低低地從樹縫照進來，樹幹的影子往右拉得很長。順著小路往右走，樹林會讓開一片空地，在畫面外面。
EP1-11-02.en: Background: The camera stands beside the trail and looks across at it. The trail is a dirt path that runs across the whole picture from the left side to the right side, tinted orange by the sunset. On the other side of the trail is a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, trunk after trunk. The setting sun is on the left side of the picture, low, shining in between the trunks, and the shadows of the trunks stretch far to the right. Further along the trail to the right the trees open up into a clearing, outside the picture.
EP1-11-02.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-11-02W.zh: 鏡頭站在小路旁邊，橫著看向小路。小路是一條泥土路，從畫面左邊橫過整個畫面延伸到右邊，被夕陽染成橘色。小路對面是一整片茂密的白堊紀森林，蘇鐵、銀杏和高大的針葉樹的樹幹一根接一根，畫面上方是一片樹冠。夕陽在畫面左邊，低低地從樹縫照進來，樹幹的影子往右拉得很長。順著小路往右走，樹林會讓開一片空地，在畫面外面。
EP1-11-02W.en: Background: The camera stands beside the trail and looks across at it. The trail is a dirt path that runs across the whole picture from the left side to the right side, tinted orange by the sunset. On the other side of the trail is a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and tall conifers, trunk after trunk, with a band of tree crowns across the top of the picture. The setting sun is on the left side of the picture, low, shining in between the trunks, and the shadows of the trunks stretch far to the right. Further along the trail to the right the trees open up into a clearing, outside the picture.
EP1-11-02W.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-11-03.zh: 鏡頭站在森林小路上，順著小路往前看。小路是一條泥土路，筆直往前延伸，最後消失在遠處的樹林裡。小路兩邊是茂密的白堊紀森林，蘇鐵、銀杏和高大的針葉樹夾著小路。夕陽就在小路正前方的樹林後面，低低的，逆光照過來，樹的輪廓邊緣發出橘色的亮光，小路上的樹影朝鏡頭拉過來。鏡頭右手邊有一片空地、鏡頭後面不遠處有一截大樹根，都在畫面外面。
EP1-11-03.en: Background: The camera stands on a forest trail and looks straight along it. The trail is a dirt path that runs straight ahead and disappears into the trees far away. On both sides of the trail is a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and tall conifers. The setting sun is low behind the trees straight ahead at the end of the trail, shining toward the camera; the edges of the trees glow orange against the light, and the tree shadows on the trail stretch toward the camera. Just to the camera's right there is a forest clearing, and a little way behind the camera a big tree root sticks out of the ground; both are outside the picture.
EP1-11-03.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-11-03W.zh: 鏡頭站在森林小路上，順著小路往前看。小路是一條泥土路，筆直往前延伸，最後消失在遠處的樹林裡。小路兩邊是茂密的白堊紀森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和高大的針葉樹。夕陽就在小路正前方的樹林後面，低低的，逆光照過來，樹的輪廓邊緣發出橘色的亮光，樹影朝鏡頭拉過來。那截大樹根就在鏡頭後面，畫面裡看不到。
EP1-11-03W.en: Background: The camera stands on a forest trail and looks straight along it. The trail is a dirt path that runs straight ahead and disappears into the trees far away. On both sides of the trail is a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and tall conifers. The setting sun is low behind the trees straight ahead at the end of the trail, shining toward the camera; the edges of the trees glow orange against the light and the tree shadows stretch toward the camera. The big tree root is just behind the camera and is not in the picture.
EP1-11-03W.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。原本寫的空地在小路右邊靠鏡頭那一段，位在鏡頭和角色之間，這次一併拿掉。

EP1-11-04.zh: 鏡頭站在小路旁邊的樹林邊上，橫著看向小路。小路是一條泥土路，從畫面左邊橫過整個畫面延伸到右邊，被夕陽染成橘色。畫面正中間，小路靠對面的那一半上有一截粗大的樹根從地面拱起來。小路對面是一大片平平的森林空地，在畫面裡左右鋪開，被夕陽照得橘亮；空地再過去是茂密的白堊紀森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，畫面右邊邊上也是樹林。夕陽在畫面左邊，低低地照過來，樹根和樹的影子往右拉得很長。
EP1-11-04.en: Background: The camera stands at the edge of the trees beside the trail and looks across at it. The trail is a dirt path that runs across the whole picture from the left side to the right side, tinted orange by the sunset. Right in the middle of the picture, on the far half of the trail, a big thick tree root sticks up out of the ground. On the other side of the trail is a wide, flat forest clearing spreading across the picture, glowing orange in the sunset light; past the clearing is a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, and there are trees at the right edge of the picture too. The setting sun is on the left side of the picture, low, and the shadows of the root and the trees stretch far to the right.

EP1-11-05.zh: 鏡頭站在小路旁邊的樹林邊上，橫著看向小路。這是近一點的鏡頭：一小段橘色的泥土小路橫過畫面，小路對面是一片平平的森林空地，被夕陽照得橘亮；空地再過去是茂密的森林，畫面右邊邊上也是樹林。夕陽在畫面左邊，低低地照過來，影子往右拉得很長。順著小路往左不遠，有一截大樹根從地面拱起來，在畫面外面。
EP1-11-05.en: Background: The camera stands at the edge of the trees beside the trail and looks across at it. This is a closer shot: a short stretch of orange dirt trail runs across the picture, and on the other side of the trail is a flat forest clearing glowing orange in the sunset light; past the clearing is dense forest, and there are trees at the right edge of the picture too. The setting sun is on the left side of the picture, low, and shadows stretch far to the right. A short way along the trail to the left a big tree root sticks up out of the ground, outside the picture.

EP1-11-05W.zh: 鏡頭站在小路旁邊的樹林邊上，橫著看向小路。小路是一條泥土路，從畫面左邊橫過畫面延伸到右邊，被夕陽染成橘色。小路對面是一片平平的森林空地，被夕陽照得橘亮；空地再過去是茂密的白堊紀森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，畫面右邊邊上也是樹林。夕陽在畫面左邊，低低地照過來，影子往右拉得很長。畫面左邊外面一點點，小路上有一截大樹根從地面拱起來，看不到。
EP1-11-05W.en: Background: The camera stands at the edge of the trees beside the trail and looks across at it. The trail is a dirt path that runs across the picture from the left side to the right side, tinted orange by the sunset. On the other side of the trail is a flat forest clearing glowing orange in the sunset light; past the clearing is a dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, and there are trees at the right edge of the picture too. The setting sun is on the left side of the picture, low, and shadows stretch far to the right. Just past the left edge of the picture a big tree root sticks up out of the trail; it is not visible.
EP1-11-05W.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-11-06.zh: 這是一間老舊兩層木造小屋的一樓，改裝成雜亂的自製科技實驗室：木板牆、木地板，低矮的木樑天花板上拉著電線、吊著幾顆燈泡。鏡頭對著掛黑板的那面牆。這是近一點的鏡頭：畫面左邊和中間是一大塊綠色黑板；畫面右邊，黑板旁邊的牆上釘著一張電影海報；畫面右上角露出旁邊那面牆上掛滿的各式時鐘，時鐘下面的角落有一張小桌，上面是用管子、齒輪和凹扁水壺拼成的自製咖啡機。早上的陽光從鏡頭後面的窗戶照進來，加上吊燈泡的暖光。大門和時光機都在鏡頭後面，畫面裡看不到。
EP1-11-06.en: Background: The ground floor of an old two-story wooden hut turned into a cluttered homemade tech lab: weathered wooden plank walls, an old wooden plank floor, and a low wooden-beam ceiling with cables strung along the beams and a few bare light bulbs hanging down. The camera faces the wall with the chalkboard. This is a closer shot: the left side and middle of the picture are a big green chalkboard; on the right side, next to the chalkboard, a movie poster is tacked to the wall; in the upper right corner part of the next wall shows, covered with dozens of mismatched clocks, and in the corner under the clocks is a small table with a rickety homemade coffee machine made of tubes, gears and a dented kettle. Morning daylight comes in through the windows behind the camera, plus the warm glow of the hanging bulbs. The front door and the time machine are behind the camera and are not in the picture.
EP1-11-06.conflict: 這格是實驗室閃回，dusk 地圖上沒有（camera.cell 是 N/A），改照 lab 地圖寫；HERO 的位置參考 lab 地圖 S02-8c（坐在黑板前、面向實驗室中間抬頭），鏡頭放在他正前方、對著黑板那面牆。另外 dusk 地圖的 S08-6 寫的是沿用 S02-8（拍博士那一格），跟這格拍 HERO 不同。prompt 的高腳凳 lab 地圖上沒有，算角色道具，背景沒寫。

EP1-11-07.zh: 鏡頭在小路正上方高高的地方，往下斜斜地看向小路旁邊的一片森林空地。空地很平，地面被夕陽照成橘色，佔滿畫面大半。空地左邊、右邊和最遠的那一頭都被茂密的白堊紀森林圍住，從上面看下去是一片蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹的樹冠。夕陽在畫面左邊，低低地照過來，左邊那排樹的影子長長地拖進空地，往右延伸。鏡頭正下方是那條泥土小路，畫面裡幾乎看不到。
EP1-11-07.en: Background: The camera is high up directly above the trail and looks down at an angle at a forest clearing next to the trail. The clearing is flat, its ground tinted orange by the sunset, and it fills most of the picture. On the left, on the right and at the far end, the clearing is surrounded by dense Cretaceous forest, seen from above as a mass of cycad, ginkgo and conifer crowns. The setting sun is on the left side of the picture, low, and the shadows of the trees on the left stretch long across the clearing toward the right. The dirt trail is directly below the camera and hardly shows in the picture.
EP1-11-07.conflict: prompt 寫 The camera is beside the trail…exactly from the side，地圖上相機（P6）在小路正上方、往下看向空地；背景照地圖寫。

EP1-11-07W.zh: 鏡頭在小路上方很高的地方，往下看向小路旁邊的一整片森林空地。空地很平，地面被夕陽照成橘色，在畫面中間攤開成一大塊。空地左邊、右邊和最遠的那一頭都被茂密的白堊紀森林圍住，從上面看下去是一大片蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹的樹冠，一直延伸到畫面邊上。夕陽在畫面左邊，低低地照過來，左邊那排樹的影子長長地拖進空地，往右延伸。鏡頭下方是那條泥土小路，畫面裡幾乎看不到。
EP1-11-07W.en: Background: The camera is very high up above the trail and looks down at a whole forest clearing next to the trail. The clearing is flat, its ground tinted orange by the sunset, and it lies open as one big patch in the middle of the picture. On the left, on the right and at the far end, the clearing is surrounded by dense Cretaceous forest, seen from above as a wide mass of cycad, ginkgo and conifer crowns reaching to the edges of the picture. The setting sun is on the left side of the picture, low, and the shadows of the trees on the left stretch long across the clearing toward the right. The dirt trail is below the camera and hardly shows in the picture.
EP1-11-07W.conflict: prompt 寫 The camera is beside the trail…exactly from the side，地圖上相機（O6）在小路上方很高處、往下看向空地；背景照地圖寫。

EP1-11-08.zh: 鏡頭站在空地邊緣的樹林邊上，看向一片森林空地。空地很平，地面被夕陽照成橘色，往遠處鋪開。畫面右邊是一條泥土小路，貼著空地的邊往遠處延伸；小路上，畫面中間偏右不遠處，有一截大樹根從地面拱起來。小路再右邊是樹林。空地左邊和最遠的那一頭都被茂密的白堊紀森林圍住，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。夕陽在鏡頭正後方，低低地照過來，樹影往前長長地拖進空地。
EP1-11-08.en: Background: The camera stands at the edge of the trees beside a forest clearing and looks into it. The clearing is flat, its ground tinted orange by the sunset, spreading out into the distance. On the right side of the picture a dirt trail runs along the edge of the clearing into the distance; on the trail, slightly right of the middle of the picture and not far away, a big tree root sticks up out of the ground. To the right of the trail is forest. On the left and at the far end, the clearing is surrounded by dense Cretaceous forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. The setting sun is directly behind the camera, low, and the tree shadows stretch long ahead across the clearing.
EP1-11-08.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。

EP1-11-08W.zh: 鏡頭看向一片森林空地。空地很平，地面被夕陽照成橘色，往遠處鋪開。畫面右邊，一條泥土小路貼著空地的邊往遠處延伸；小路上，畫面中間偏右的遠處有一截大樹根從地面拱起來。小路再右邊是樹林。空地左邊和最遠的那一頭被茂密的蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹圍住。夕陽在鏡頭正後方，低低地照過來，樹影往前長長地拖進空地。
EP1-11-08W.en: Background: The camera looks toward a forest clearing. The clearing is flat, its ground tinted orange by the sunset, spreading out into the distance. On the right side of the picture a dirt trail runs along the edge of the clearing into the distance; far along the trail, slightly right of the middle of the picture, a big tree root sticks up out of the ground. To the right of the trail is forest. On the left and at the far end, the clearing is surrounded by dense cycads, ginkgos and conifers. The setting sun is directly behind the camera, low, and the tree shadows stretch long ahead across the clearing.
EP1-11-08W.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。相機（J5）在樹林裡，照使用者決定當作沒有樹擋住，鏡頭和空地之間的樹幹、葉子都拿掉。

EP1-11-09.zh: 鏡頭看向一片森林空地。空地很平，地面被夕陽照成橘色，往遠處鋪開。畫面右邊，一條泥土小路貼著空地的邊往遠處延伸；小路上，畫面中間偏右的遠處有一截大樹根從地面拱起來。小路再右邊是樹林。空地左邊和最遠的那一頭被茂密的蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹圍住。夕陽在鏡頭正後方，低低地照過來，樹影往前長長地拖進空地。
EP1-11-09.en: Background: The camera looks toward a forest clearing. The clearing is flat, its ground tinted orange by the sunset, spreading out into the distance. On the right side of the picture a dirt trail runs along the edge of the clearing into the distance; far along the trail, slightly right of the middle of the picture, a big tree root sticks up out of the ground. To the right of the trail is forest. On the left and at the far end, the clearing is surrounded by dense cycads, ginkgos and conifers. The setting sun is directly behind the camera, low, and the tree shadows stretch long ahead across the clearing.
EP1-11-09.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。相機（J5）在樹林裡，照使用者決定當作沒有樹擋住。prompt 寫 The camera is on the trail ahead of TEEN，地圖上相機（J5）在小路旁的樹林裡、看向空地；背景照地圖寫。

EP1-11-10.zh: 鏡頭貼著空地的地面，往上看向空地邊緣的樹林。不遠處空地到了盡頭，一整排高大的蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹像牆一樣立起來。因為鏡頭很低，樹幹往上聳得很高，樹冠遮住大半天空。畫面左邊邊上，一條泥土小路沿著空地邊緣往遠處延伸，鑽進樹林。夕陽就在正前方的樹林後面，低低的，逆光照過來，樹的輪廓邊緣發出橘色的亮光。那截大樹根在鏡頭左後方，畫面裡看不到。
EP1-11-10.en: Background: The camera sits right on the ground of a forest clearing and looks up toward the trees at the edge of the clearing. Not far away the clearing ends and a row of tall cycads, ginkgos and conifers stands up like a wall. Because the camera is so low, the trunks rise very high and the tree crowns cover most of the sky. At the left edge of the picture a dirt trail runs along the edge of the clearing into the distance and disappears into the trees. The setting sun is low behind the trees straight ahead, shining toward the camera, and the edges of the trees glow orange against the light. The big tree root is behind the camera on the left and is not in the picture.
EP1-11-10.conflict: 2026-11-13 照新規定拿掉前面的東西。prompt 寫 The camera is on the trail ahead of TEEN，地圖上相機（O5）在空地裡，小路在畫面左邊；背景照地圖寫。

EP1-11-11.zh: 鏡頭站在森林小路上，順著小路往前看。這是近一點的鏡頭：橘色的泥土小路往前延伸，小路上不遠處，畫面中間偏左有一截大樹根從地面拱起來。小路右邊的樹林讓開一片平平的空地，被夕陽照得橘亮，空地再過去是茂密的森林；小路左邊是一整片蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹的樹林。夕陽在畫面正前方偏左，低低地掛在樹林後面，逆光照過來，樹的輪廓邊緣發出橘色的亮光。
EP1-11-11.en: Background: The camera stands on a forest trail and looks along it. This is a closer shot: the orange dirt trail stretches ahead, and not far along it, slightly left of the middle of the picture, a big tree root sticks up out of the ground. On the right side of the trail the trees open up into a flat forest clearing glowing orange in the sunset light, with dense forest past it; on the left side of the trail is a forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. The setting sun hangs low behind the trees ahead, slightly left of the middle, shining toward the camera, and the edges of the trees glow orange against the light.
